consequence.statement: Compose function errors about a composite resource are reported in more detail. Nothing breaks or needs operator action.

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds more detail to compose function error messages when there is an issue with the composite resource; this changes only diagnostics, not configuration.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The note only covers error message wording for compose functions. No setting, field, flag or API is named, so no subject family fits.; change: There is no typed subject. The text only says the error messages are more detailed and gives no before or after wording.; applicability: No configuration predicate is involved. The change only affects diagnostic messages emitted when a composite resource has an issue.
